description: Measure how much longer or shorter each translation is than its base string. A translation much longer than the base overflows or truncates in a layout built to the base length; one much shorter is usually content that did not make it across, and both are reported with the ratio. Length is counted in code points, so an emoji is not counted twice, and a short absolute difference is never reported however large the ratio. Pay 140000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

locales.description: The locale files to measure. One entry per locale. Exactly one may be marked as the base; when none is, the first supplied is used and that is reported.

errors.generic: Something went wrong while loading your data
Beim Laden Ihrer Daten ist ein Fehler aufgetreten

base.description: Whether this is the source locale the others are compared against.

locale.description: A language tag such as en, pt-BR or ar.

messages.description: This locale’s messages. A messages object, or JSON text, at most 2097152 bytes. Nested objects are flattened to separated keys, so a file written either way is read the same. Nothing is fetched: the files are supplied, so an arbitrary project can be audited.

longer_tolerance.description: The ratio above which a translation is reported as much longer. Defaults to 1.6.

max_characters.description: Per key, the longest a message may be. Omitting it means ratios are relative to the base rather than to a layout.

shorter_tolerance.description: The ratio below which a translation is reported as much shorter. Defaults to 0.4.

name: locale_layout_risk_audit

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

locales.description: Per locale: how many were compared, how many were much longer or shorter, and the mean ratio, which is the figure that tells a designer how much slack a layout needs.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

within_tolerance.description: True only when every compared message sat inside the stated ratios and every declared limit.
